corrections.title: NSW Department of Education: Public School Enrolment and Designated Intake Areas
corrections.quote: The designated intake areas are determined by the Department of Education. These schools ensure that there are enough places for students who reside in their local enrolment area.
corrections.summary: The NSW Department of Education determines designated intake areas to ensure sufficient student places for residents in local public school enrolment areas.

corrections.title: Washington State Legislature: Residential Landlord-Tenant Act (RCW Chapter 59.18)
corrections.quote: 59.18.010 Short title. HTML PDF 59.18.020 Rights and remedies — Obligation of good faith imposed.
corrections.summary: Under Chapter 59.18 of the Revised Code of Washington, the Residential Landlord-Tenant Act establishes statutory rights and remedies for residential tenancies and imposes an obligation of good faith on both landlords and tenants.
